# Digital Ninja Technologies

> Empowering brands and start-ups with impactful digital solutions through strategic design and development.

Digital Ninja Technologies is a full-service digital agency based in Nigeria, specialising in product design, software development, mobile apps, AI automation, and MVP development for startups, SMEs, and enterprises across Africa and globally.

## About

Digital Ninja Technologies helps founders, brands, and organisations build high-quality digital products. The team combines strategic design thinking with modern software engineering to deliver products that convert and scale.

**Location:** Nigeria (serving clients globally)
**Contact:** Info@thedigitalninjatech.com | +2348145865720
**Website:** https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com

## Services

- **Custom Software Development** — Scalable software solutions tailored to specific business needs
- **Website Design & Development** — Corporate websites, landing pages, web portals, and web applications
- **Mobile App Development** — iOS and Android applications with modern, intuitive user experiences
- **AI Solutions & Automation** — AI-powered tools, chatbots, workflow automation, and business intelligence
- **UI/UX Design** — User-centered interface design that improves engagement and drives conversions
- **MVP Development** — Rapid product development for startups to validate ideas and reach market quickly

## Selected Work

- **Flex2Ride** — Ride-hailing platform: full product design including rider app, driver app, and marketing website
- **Mixlr** — Live audio broadcasting platform redesign; improved listener and broadcaster UX
- **Coinly** — Personal finance app: onboarding, dashboard, transaction history, and goal-setting flows
- **Digital Ninja Technologies** — Own brand identity and design system

## Referral Programme

Digital Ninja Technologies offers a 10% commission referral programme. Refer a business, startup, or organisation that signs a project, and earn 10% of the project value.

- ₦500,000 project = ₦50,000 commission
- ₦1,000,000 project = ₦100,000 commission
- ₦5,000,000 project = ₦500,000 commission
